name: Year-to-date
description: Evaluates the base measure from the start of the year through the last visible date.

name: Quarter-to-date
description: Evaluates the base measure from the start of the quarter through the last visible date.

name: Month-to-date
description: Evaluates the base measure from the start of the month through the last visible date.

name: Moving annual total
description: Evaluates the trailing 12-month window ending on the last visible date.

name: Previous year
description: Shifts the current date context backward by one year.

name: Previous quarter
description: Shifts the current date context backward by one quarter.

name: Previous month
description: Shifts the current date context backward by one month.

name: Previous year complete
description: Evaluates the complete calendar year immediately before the year containing the last visible date.

name: Previous quarter complete
description: Evaluates the complete quarter immediately before the quarter containing the last visible date.

name: Previous month complete
description: Evaluates the complete month immediately before the month containing the last visible date.

name: Previous period
description: Selects previous month, quarter, or year from the active date hierarchy level.

name: Previous year moving annual total
description: Evaluates the comparable trailing 12-month window ending one year before the last visible date.

name: Year-over-year
description: Calculates percentage change versus the comparable context one year earlier.

name: Quarter-over-quarter
description: Calculates percentage change versus the comparable context one quarter earlier.

name: Month-over-month
description: Calculates percentage change versus the comparable context one month earlier.

name: Moving annual total growth
description: Calculates percentage growth between MAT and the comparable MAT ending one year earlier.

name: Period-over-period
description: Calculates percentage change from the previous month, quarter, or year based on hierarchy scope.

name: Previous year-to-date
description: Evaluates the prior year through the corresponding elapsed position in the current period.

name: Previous quarter-to-date
description: Evaluates the prior quarter through the corresponding elapsed position in the current period.

name: Previous month-to-date
description: Evaluates the prior month through the corresponding elapsed position in the current period.

name: Year-over-year-to-date
description: Calculates percentage change between the current period-to-date value and the comparable prior year-to-date value.

name: Quarter-over-quarter-to-date
description: Calculates percentage change between the current period-to-date value and the comparable prior quarter-to-date value.

name: Month-over-month-to-date
description: Calculates percentage change between the current period-to-date value and the comparable prior month-to-date value.

name: Year-to-date over previous year
description: Calculates percentage change between current YTD and the complete previous calendar year.

name: Quarter-to-date over previous quarter
description: Calculates percentage change between current QTD and the complete previous quarter.

name: Month-to-date over previous month
description: Calculates percentage change between current MTD and the complete previous month.

name: Custom Spacing
description: Aligns two formatted measure values by inserting invisible spacing characters.

name: Divergent Color
description: Returns a color based on the selected-range position of the current measure value.

name: Drill Through Monthly Text
description: Returns monthly drill-through text when a parameter is selected.

name: Drill Through Daily Text
description: Returns daily drill-through text when a parameter is selected.

name: Measure Selection
description: Field parameter for switching between published measures.

name: Month Filter Card
description: Displays selected months in a card visual.

name: Sensitive Data
description: Returns data only when the required permission exists.

name: Period Change Icon
description: Compares current MTD to prior month and returns an icon.

name: Card with Columns No Target
description: Returns an SVG card with a slicer-aware callout and a trailing-month column chart.

name: Card with Columns and Target
description: Returns an SVG KPI card with columns, a target line, period labels, and summary text.

name: Card with Text Only
description: Returns an SVG KPI card containing primary, secondary, and target-summary text.

name: Notification Icon
description: Returns an SVG notification bell with a badge showing the number of actionable groups.

name: Star Rating SVG
description: Returns an SVG rating made from full, half, and empty stars.

name: Calendar with Details SVG
description: Returns an SVG calendar grid with completed, qualifying, and remaining-day details.

name: Donut Target Progress SVG
description: Returns an SVG donut showing target, current value, and the amount over or under target.

name: Add Synthetic Row
description: Adds a synthetic row to an existing table.
